page.title: AfriNuts Batch Traceability
page.subtitle: Track every batch from harvest to processing
page.description: View detailed information about this batch, from harvest to processing and quality checks.
page.about: Our unique traceability system allows you to scan a QR code and instantly see detailed information about each batch: harvest date, farm location, processing method, certifications, and quality checks. This ensures transparency, quality, and trust for our customers and partners.
